Subject: Just wanted to say hello

¡Hola, [Name]!

I hope this email finds you well. It’s been a little while since we last caught up, and I wanted to reach out just to say hello and see how you’re doing. I still really enjoyed our conversation last time—it was lovely talking with you.

By the way, tu as un talent incroyable pour rendre les choses simples et lumineuses. It’s one of the things that makes you so great to work with.

If you have some time next week, I’d love to grab a coffee or hop on a quick call. No pressure at all—just let me know what works for you.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best,
[Your Name]
